checkerFindings.note: Confirmed: the glm p1-fig1 crop contains only Задача 2 text, no photo. The checker nevertheless missed the other eight defective glm crops (every one clips or swallows text), so its 'figuresChecked: 9' overstates its coverage.
Confirmed on problems p.2: „вълшебникът и мечтателят, надарен“; haiku has „възвишеният, нарален“. (The checker's own suggestedFix repeats haiku's „птува“ for the printed „пътува“.)

Confirmed: the crop shows masthead and statement text and the photo is clipped at the bottom. The photo actually spans about 352–457‰ vertically, so the checker's suggested [690,295,910,460] would still swallow two statement lines; gold uses [674,346,914,462].
Confirmed: the crop swallows „принц,“ / „теж и“ at the left; it also includes the top of the parachute illustration and „рашут.“, which the checker did not mention.

The box is indeed wrong, but the description is imprecise: the swallowed text in this crop is „амира в асансьор, движещ се“ (the „рашут.“ fragment is in the previous crop), and the checker missed that the entire canopy is cut off — the drawing spans 321–449‰, so its suggested [700,378,900,500] would still clip it.

Confirmed: the suspension thread is cut and body text is swallowed; the swallowed fragment is „10 m/s².“ from the g-note, not „амира в асансьор“ (that is in the previous crop). The suggested [690,522,900,675] is acceptable.
Confirmed: printed „за целия изминат път s“, haiku „за целия измин на пътя“.
Confirmed: printed „Пилот изпробва“ and „При числените“; haiku „Пилотът“ and „численгите“.
Confirmed: the source prints decimal commas; haiku writes 12.48, 0.38, [0.5 т.], 16.2 etc. across all three problems while keeping $1{,}6$.
Confirmed on solutions p.1: „ще бъде“ and „колоездач B е изпреварил колоездач A с 4,8 m“; haiku „още е“ and „колоездача B е изпревари колоездач A с 4.8 m“.
Confirmed: part в) of the Задача 3 solution is on solutions p.3; haiku lists only p.2.
Confirmed by code-point scan: „правoлинейно“ with U+006F in both the part б) statement and the solution (haiku also has „стъкленa“ with a Latin a in the p3-fig3 alt).

Confirmed: the crop shows „б) За“ above the diagram. The checker missed that the same box also cuts the block's right edge (278 px vs 284 px), so its suggested [30,830,210,940] would still clip; gold uses [142,832,224,922]. Rated critical rather than major.

The path does not exist (Задача 3 is /problems/2). On the substance: the g-note is printed after the last part and applies to the whole problem; the schema has no slot after parts[], so placing it at the end of the statement (as the published corpus and the gold do) is the accepted convention, not a rewording.

Wrong path (Задача 1 is /problems/0) and wrong conclusion: the corpus transcribes illustrations printed beside a problem, so the gold carries the photo as p1-fig1 and the omission is a (minor) defect, not a legitimate omission.

summary: Sonnet is the closest candidate: its text is verbatim apart from one Latin letter, one dropped italic and a moved paragraph, but it omits the four printed illustrations and two of its five solution boxes clip the drawing (one also swallows the „б) За“ heading). Haiku garbles Problem 3's opening sentence, drops the g-note, the precision instruction and the catapult glossary, proposes no solution figures and its four boxes all swallow text; glm's text is nearly verbatim but all nine of its figure boxes are wrong (one shows only Problem 2 text, the rest clip labels or swallow neighbouring text and figures). Of the 16 checker findings 14 are true positives; the haiku checker found one of glm's nine bad crops, and glm's two false positives against sonnet are a nonexistent path and a mistaken 'decorative figure legitimately omitted' claim.
